title: Constructing binder-free 3D thermal networks with hexagonal boron nitride of varying sizes to enhance polydimethylsiloxane composites: a comparative study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17388-17396
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01204J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Liping Han, Hu Sun, Wei Li, Li Liu, Guoyou Gan, Zhuo Qian, Junpeng Li
A binder-free 3D BN thermal network is constructed in a PDMS matrix using a hard-template method. The impact of BN flake size on thermal conductivity is systematically investigated.
